description: Update a span-based metric's filter, group-by, or percentile settings

filterQuery.description: Updated APM search query to filter spans

groupBy.description: Updated fields to group the metric by

path.description: Path to the value to aggregate over. Example: @resource_name

tagName.description: Tag name for the group. Defaults to path if not specified

includePercentiles.description: Whether to include percentile aggregations. Only for distribution metrics

metricId.description: The name of the span-based metric to update

name: update-spans-metric
